gpu-rounded-stack.title: GPU scene · rounded forms and style precedence
gpu-rounded-stack.label: GPU rounded stack
gpu-rounded-stack.description: Three rounded boxes share a type style. The center ID retains its smaller radius and opposite Y rotation when the later type rule changes the side boxes.

expected.basis: Source-resolved values; image appearance also depends on the viewer's lighting and camera.

validEdit.meaning: Increase only the side rounding radii; the center ID radius remains .06.

badEdit.reason: Radius .4 exceeds half the smallest outer size .7 for the side boxes.

gpu-crossed-capsules.title: GPU scene · local capsule segments and a rotated ring
gpu-crossed-capsules.label: GPU crossed capsules
gpu-crossed-capsules.description: Two locally defined capsule segments rotate in opposite Z directions. A torus rotates toward the camera; translation places each object separately.

expected.basis: Source-resolved values; no group transform or Boolean operation.

validEdit.meaning: Turn the torus from its front-facing view to its local XZ plane.

badEdit.reason: Capsule start and end would be identical, with no usable Float32 separation.

material-transition-window.title: GPU material · combine a palette and a transition window
material-transition-window.label: Material transition window
material-transition-window.description: Clamp a remapped host amount, ease it through a bounded window, then mix two RGB colors. The source changes material color only; the mesh stays the same.

expected.basis: Source-derived scalar ratios; not gamma-converted pixels.

validEdit.meaning: Change the cold endpoint from blue to green while retaining the same amount expression.

badEdit.reason: Smoothstep requires ordered literal edges with the lower edge strictly less than the upper edge.
